items.stem: Two senior team members keep clashing over technical design and it is delaying the work. What should the project manager do FIRST?

options.rationale: Escalating straight away skips the PM's own job of resolving team conflict.

options.text: Meet both members to understand the root cause and work together on a solution
options.rationale: Correct: collaborating / problem-solving deals with the cause and is the preferred first approach.

options.text: Assign the design decision to the more senior member
options.rationale: Forcing a result may resolve things in the short term but damages team cohesion.

options.text: Remove one member from the project
options.rationale: This is a last resort and premature here.

items.explanation: Correct: collaborating / problem-solving deals with the cause and is the preferred first approach.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: In an adaptive project, who is mainly responsible for maximising product value by ordering the backlog?

options.rationale: The sponsor funds the work and champions it, but does not order the backlog.
Correct: the product owner orders the backlog to maximise value.
The facilitator serves the team and removes impediments.
Developers estimate and deliver items. They do not own backlog order.

items.explanation: Correct: the product owner orders the backlog to maximise value.

items.stem: A new regulation affects the project's deliverables halfway through. Which domain does handling this mainly fall under?

options.rationale: This is not mainly a team or leadership issue.
Process covers the change control that follows, but recognising external compliance impacts belongs to Business Environment.
Correct: compliance and changes in the external environment sit in Business Environment.

options.text: None - regulations are out of PMP scope
options.rationale: Compliance is explicitly within PMP scope.

items.explanation: Correct: compliance and changes in the external environment sit in Business Environment.
